# @dhmodel/duix-sdk

Node SDK for the same pipeline as `client` + `duix-sdk`:

- shared model: `client/resource/gj_dh_res` (`wenet.o`, `weight_168u.b`)
- role model: `output/<role>/wasm/dh_model.wasm` (NCNN weights only)
- role pictures: `output/<role>/raw_jpgs`, `bbox.j`, `config.j`

Wenet runs in-process with `onnxruntime-node`. The mouth network is NCNN, loaded in-process from `native/duix_ncnn.dll`. `dh_model.wasm` stores an ncnn2mem binary param (no blob names); the loader uses `load_param_bin` and the blob ids in `dh_model.id.h` (`audio=0`, `face=1`, `output=180`). Audio features, face crop, and paste-back stay in JavaScript.

## Install

```bash
cd js/duix-sdk
npm install
```

Mouth inference loads `native/duix_ncnn.dll` (override with `DUIX_NCNN_DLL`). Rebuild that library with the Visual Studio x64 prompt if it is missing:

```bat
cd js\duix-sdk\native
build.bat
```

## Drive a WAV

```bash
node examples/drive-wav.js path\to\16k.wav path\to\frames
```

Any 16-bit WAV is resampled to 16 kHz mono. One JPEG is written every 40 ms.

## API

```js
import { Duix } from "@dhmodel/duix-sdk";

const duix = new Duix({
  baseDir: "D:/DHModel/client/resource/gj_dh_res",
  roleDir: "D:/DHModel/output/语熙",
});
await duix.init();
await duix.driveWav("speech.wav", { outDir: "./out" });
duix.close();
```

`pushPcm(int16le)` then `render(frameIndex, audioIndex)` is the same loop if you already have PCM.

`init()` decrypts `wenet.o` once into `js/duix-sdk/.cache/` and unpacks `dh_model.wasm` into `param` + `bin` for NCNN.
